heading: How I Work
intro: From a business idea to a product in people's hands — this is the path every project takes with me, and what you get at each step.

steps.title: Idea & Discovery
steps.desc: It starts with your business idea. We talk through the goal, the users and what success looks like, then turn it into a clear scope, priorities and a realistic timeline.

steps.title: Research
steps.desc: Before building, I research: who the users are, what competitors do, and what's technically possible. This is where I pick the right stack and spot risks early.

steps.title: UI/UX Design
steps.desc: The research becomes user flows, wireframes and a clickable Figma prototype. We test the experience before a single line of production code is written.

steps.title: Backend & Logic
steps.desc: Then the engine: system architecture, database design and secure REST APIs — authentication, payments, real-time notifications and every business rule behind the screens.

steps.title: Web & Mobile App
steps.desc: With the API in place, my team and I build the product people actually use — Next.js web apps and dashboards, and Flutter mobile apps for iOS and Android.

steps.title: Launch & Grow
steps.desc: We test, optimize and ship. After launch I stay close — monitoring, fixing and iterating with you so the product keeps getting better as it grows.
